turns.content:
This is the problem! The changes show that `>=` was changed to `>` in multiple places. This is incorrect because:
- The condition `nobs >= minp` means "when we have at least `minp` observations"
- Changing it to `nobs > minp` means "when we have more than `minp` observations"

This breaks the logic - when we have exactly `minp` observations, the function should compute the result, but with `>` it will return NaN instead.
